title: Bitcoin for taxes? Proposed bill would let Americans pay the IRS in BTC
summary: Tax revenue denominated in Bitcoin would be funneled into the US strategic BTC reserve and would not trigger a taxable event for the payer.

title: Advocacy groups urge Trump to intervene in the Roman Storm retrial
summary: Already convicted of one felony charge and facing a possible retrial on two others, the Tornado Cash co-founder’s future is uncertain.

title: Bitcoin, stocks crumble after Nvidia earnings and Fed uncertainty over next rate cut
summary: Bitcoin weakness persists as the BTC price drops to $86,000, alongside a US stock market sell-off and diminishing odds of a 50-basis-point Fed interest rate cut at the next FOMC.

title: Coinbase launches ETH-backed loans as onchain lending tops $1.25B
summary: Users can borrow up to $1 million in USDC against their Ether as Coinbase expands its Base-powered network, which has processed $1.25 billion in loans.

title: India’s government may consider stablecoin framework, diverging from RBI
summary: India’s government is considering adopting a stablecoin regulatory framework while the Reserve Bank of India urges a "cautious" approach.

title: Bitcoin downtrend accelerates, but traders eye short liquidity at $100K
summary: Bitcoin struggles to hold the $90,000 support, and while charts angle toward further price downside, traders have turned their attention to the short liquidity at $98,000 to $100,000.

title: SEC enforcement actions dropped 30% under Paul Atkins: Report
summary: The transition from Gary Gensler to Paul Atkins led to a significant decline in enforcement cases across the board, including those involving crypto companies.

title: Tether backs Parfin to push institutional USDT adoption across Latin America
summary: The investment will help Parfin expand its onchain settlement tools and strengthen stablecoin infrastructure that is already driving institutional crypto use in LATAM.

title: Aztec launches decentralized and private Ethereum L2 on mainnet, almost
